name: Ten of Pentacles
keywords: a base passed down the generations

facts.elder-dogs: In front, a white-haired old man in a richly patterned robe sits stroking a white dog.
facts.two-dogs: Two white dogs have come up to the old man.
facts.couple-arch: Under a large arch stand a man (seen from behind) and a woman.
facts.child: A child by the hem of the woman's dress reaches a hand toward a dog.
facts.ten-pentacles: Ten pentacles are laid over the scene in a regular shape.
facts.arch-shields: On the left pillar is a heraldic shield with a castle and scales painted on it.
facts.town-tower: A tower and houses can be seen beyond the arch.

glosses.elder-dogs: Care and loyalty that connect to the generation before.
glosses.ten-pentacles: Pentacles laid out in the shape of the tree of life; a base that seems scattered yet is connected.

reversedGloss.blocked: Stability is blocked by family or property matters.

misdescriptions.wrong: The old man drives the dogs away.
